name: 3rie Gordon
bio:
3rie Gordon is a masterful tattoo artist specializing in intricate floral and fineline designs, boasting a portfolio that beautifully reflects their Coast Salish and Bad River Chippewa heritage. Operating out of Equinox Art Collective in Woodstock, GA, 3rie is renowned not just for their exceptional artistry, but also for maintaining a scrupulously clean working environment. Clients can expect a top-tier experience in both the quality of the tattoos and the pristine condition of the studio.
